Case A: A prescriber issues several separate Schedule II prescriptions on one date and proposes postdating the later prescriptions' issue dates.

Case B: One prescription has an earliest-fill date 60 days after the actual issuance, and staff rely only on the federal multiple-prescription allowance to use it in Massachusetts.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: Separate prescriptions under this pathway are not refills of one Schedule II prescription.
A.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 여러 original prescription과 refill을 구분한다.

B.original_option_text: The prescriptions use their actual issue dates, with separate appropriate earliest-fill instructions.
B.original_rationale_ko: 옳은 설명이므로 오류 선택의 정답이 아님. 실제 발행일과 earliest-fill instruction은 별도 항목이다.

C.original_option_text: A total of 90 days alone establishes compliance with every condition of the federal pathway.
C.original_rationale_ko:
오류를 고르는 문항의 정답. 90일 총량 외 실제 해당 허용 조건을 충족해야 한다.
교정된 설명: The federal pathway includes legitimate purpose, diversion-risk assessment, and state-law conditions.

D.original_option_text: The federal allowance does not eliminate Massachusetts's separately applicable validity limitation.

Case A: A patient wants a Schedule II medicine quickly, but appropriate alternative treatment is available and a lawful written prescription can reasonably be supplied before dispensing.

Case B: Another case involves an electronic-system outage, and staff assume the outage alone satisfies every federal emergency-oral criterion.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: An oral emergency converts Schedule II into a refillable prescription.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 응급 format 허용과 no-refill 원칙은 다른 조건이다.
교정된 설명: The emergency pathway does not create refill authority for the Schedule II prescription.

B.original_option_text: Any electronic outage is automatically a qualifying oral Schedule II emergency.

records.original_stem:
Case A: For a proposed federal emergency oral Schedule II prescription, the prescriber's receptionist calls a certified technician instead of the prescribing practitioner speaking to the pharmacist.

Case B: A central-fill pharmacy proposes accepting the emergency oral prescription directly under the ordinary retail emergency pathway.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The pharmacist may dispense first and postpone all oral-order recording until the follow-up arrives.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 최초 oral authorization의 필수 정보를 즉시 기록한다.
교정된 설명: The pharmacist must promptly reduce the required oral information to a record.

B.original_option_text: A central-fill pharmacy may accept the emergency oral Schedule II order through the same retail pathway.
B.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. §1306.11(d)의 central-fill 제한을 유지한다.
교정된 설명: The federal emergency-oral provision does not allow the central-fill pharmacy to receive it through that pathway.

C.original_option_text: The specified federal emergency pathway requires the prescribing individual practitioner to authorize the pharmacist.
C.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 일반 agent 전달·CPhT III–VI 수신과 emergency CII 직접 practitioner-to-pharmacist를 구별한다.

D.original_option_text: An unknown caller's assertion of being a prescriber removes the need for authenticity verification.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 모르는 prescriber의 진정성을 합리적 방법으로 확인한다.
교정된 설명: An unfamiliar prescriber requires reasonable authenticity verification.

records.original_stem:
Case A: An emergency oral Schedule II order is authorized on Monday, but the first quantity is dispensed Tuesday; the pharmacy starts the federal follow-up clock on Tuesday.

Case B: After the federal follow-up period expires without the required prescription, staff merely write 'not received' in the file.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A.original_option_text: The follow-up prescription authorizes an extra duplicate supply in addition to the emergency quantity.
A.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 후속 서류는 동일 emergency supply의 기록이며 새 추가 수량이 아니다.
교정된 설명: The follow-up covers the emergency quantity and links to the original oral record.

B.original_option_text: The federal follow-up clock starts with oral authorization rather than the later dispensing date.
B.original_rationale_ko: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. 이 문항은 federal follow-up의 clock를 묻는다. MA 별도 더 이른 의무의 통합 결론을 내리지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: A file note alone replaces the DEA notification required for a missing follow-up.
C.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 후속 미수령 기록과 DEA 통지는 다른 행동이다.
교정된 설명: Failure to receive the required follow-up triggers the stated DEA notification duty.

D.original_option_text: The federal seven-day period may be treated as seven business days whenever weekends intervene.
D.original_rationale_ko:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Federal 7 days와 MA 문서의 business-day 표현을 섞지 않는다.
교정된 설명: The federal seven-day period must not be lengthened to seven business days.
